implementation: the owning command or coordination contract
source changes do not authorize binary installation, live database changes or session restarts
review: the canonical Issue and acceptance mapping

fast: targeted tests and format checks for the touched contracts
review: Start review at the first complete stable diff after fast gates and self-review; preserve exact-revision admission and one in-flight review
review the complete base...head diff and satisfy the repository review policy

risk_probes: For claim, reservation or migration changes, test atomicity, fencing, idempotency and negative paths with isolated state.
